results.rule: Hour drive 10:00: when the 10:00-11:00 hour moves at least 0.2x the typical day range, trade its direction from 11:00 on days the 09:00 hour did not already qualify as an opening drive; stop half the remaining range away; flat 16:00.
Two-hour drive: on days without a 09:00 opening drive, a 09:00-11:00 move of at least 0.35x the typical day range sets the direction from 11:00; stop half the remaining range away; flat 16:00.
Hour drive 08:00: when the 08:00-09:00 hour moves at least 0.2x the typical day range, trade its direction from 09:00; stop half the remaining range away; flat 16:00.
Hour drive 03:00: when the 03:00-04:00 hour moves at least 0.15x the typical day range, trade its direction from 04:00; stop half the remaining range away; flat 16:00.
Hour drive 13:00: when the 13:00-14:00 hour moves at least 0.15x the typical day range, trade its direction from 14:00; stop half the remaining range away; flat 16:00.
Overnight range breakout: stop orders at the 18:00-09:00 high and low, accepted 09:00-14:00 (whichever trades first); stop at the 09:00 open; flat 16:00.
Overnight continuation: when 09:00 opens at least 0.25x the typical day range away from the prior 16:00 close, trade in that direction at 09:00; stop half the remaining range away; flat 16:00.
Overnight continuation: when 09:00 opens at least 0.5x the typical day range away from the prior 16:00 close, trade in that direction at 09:00; stop half the remaining range away; flat 16:00.

Prior-day close location (momentum): when the prior day's 16:00 close was in the top or bottom fifth of its full range, trade in the same direction at 09:00; stop half the remaining range away; flat 16:00.
Prior-day close location (reversal): when the prior day's 16:00 close was in the top or bottom fifth of its full range, trade against it at 09:00; stop half the remaining range away; flat 16:00.
Inside-hour breakout: when the 10:00-11:00 hour stays inside the 09:00-10:00 range, stop orders beyond that range from 11:00 to 14:00; stop at the far side; flat 16:00.
